_about: Public-domain Frances Ridley Havergal (1836-1879, Church of England hymn writer and devotional author) for the Word Hoard: Kept for the Master's Use from CCEL (Philadelphia: Henry Altemus, 1895), and 12 more from Internet Archive scans, among them My King, Royal Commandments, Royal Bounty and The Royal Invitation (1877-1878), Starlight through the Shadows (1882) and three books of her verse. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 22 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
